content:
The Full Syllabus chapter is a high-yield part of the CAT Quantitative Aptitude section, and a favourite in XAT, SNAP, NMAT and CMAT too. This guide explains what CAT Full Syllabus tests, the formulas and shortcuts worth memorising, the mistakes that cost marks, and a free 10-question online test you can take right now.

Take the quiz below first, read the explanation for anything you miss, then use the chapter e-book at the end for full, exam-level practice.

What CAT asks on Full Syllabus

A balanced mix of questions from every CAT Quant chapter — arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, number system and modern maths.

Key formulas & shortcuts

  • Attempt full papers under time to build exam stamina.
  • Review every wrong answer — note the concept, not just the option.
  • Regular mocks are the best predictor of your real Quant score.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Practising only chapter-wise and never a full mixed paper.
  • Skipping the review step after a mock.
  • Ignoring time management until exam day.

quiz.title: CAT Quant Practice Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten CAT-pattern questions across topics. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: If A is 125% of B, then B is what percentage of (A + B)?
questions.explanation: Let B = 100. Since A is 125% of B, A = 125. The sum (A + B) = 125 + 100 = 225. We need to find what percentage B is of (A + B). Required percentage = (B / (A + B)) * 100 = (100 / 225) * 100 = (4 / 9) * 100 = 44.44%.

questions.q: A merchant marks his goods up by 40% and then offers a discount of 20%. What is his overall profit percentage?
If a: b = 2: 3, b: c = 4: 5, and c: d = 6: 7, find the continued ratio a: b: c: d.
questions.explanation:
Step 1: a:b=2:3, b:c=4:5, c:d=6:7.
Step 2: Make b common. LCM(3,4)=12. a:b=8:12, b:c=12:15. So a:b:c=8:12:15.
Step 3: Make c common. LCM(15,6)=30. Multiply a:b:c by 2 → 16:24:30. Multiply c:d by 5 → c:d=30:35.
Answer: a:b:c:d = 16:24:30:35.

questions.q: The average age of a group of 10 people is 25 years. If a new person aged 35 joins the group, what is the new average age?
questions.explanation: Total age of 10 people = 10 * 25 = 250 years. Adding the new person: 250 + 35 = 285. New average = 285 / 11 ≈ 25.909. However, the closest integer is 26.

questions.q: In what ratio must a mixture of 20% alcohol and another mixture of 40% alcohol be mixed to obtain a 25% alcohol solution?
A sum of money invested at simple interest amounts to Rs. 880 in 2 years and to Rs. 920 in 3 years. Find the principal and the rate of interest per annum.
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Understand that simple interest remains constant every year.
Step 2: SI for 1 year = Amount in 3 years - Amount in 2 years = 920 - 880 = Rs. 40.

questions.q: If a,b,c are odd integers and ax²+bx+c=0 has real roots, then
questions.explanation: b²-4ac: an odd square is ≡1 (mod 8) and 4ac≡4 (mod 8), so the discriminant ≡5 (mod 8), which is never a perfect square. Hence the (real) roots are irrational.
Factoring both quadratics and applying log domain conditions ( 2x+3 0,≠1 etc.) leaves only x=-(1)/(4).

questions.q: Positive numbers α,β,γ are in A.P. If α x²+2β x+γ=0 and x²+2px+1=0 ( p≠1 ) have a common root, then (α)/(γ), p, (γ)/(α) are in
questions.explanation: Since 2β=α+γ, the first equation factors with root x=-1 (rejected as p≠1 ) and x=-γ/α. Using the common root in the second gives 2p=(α)/(γ)+(γ)/(α), i.e. p is the mean — so (α)/(γ),p,(γ)/(α) are in A.P.
